scientific_limitations: Only full powerset semirings of strict comparable-pair semigroups of finite posets, in the constant-free union/multiplication signature. Main equivalence uses Wang–Yin–Wang Theorem 1.1 (2026) for all nontrivial nilpotent semigroups. No independent theorem-proof verification or absolute historical-priority certification. Do not conflate this full power semiring with the flat interval semiring of Gao–Zhou.
title: Height-three finite-basis threshold for strict interval power semirings
